proposal.hypothesis: The serial r-k-c variant measured 0.076396257 s, while row-parallel r-k-c without explicit SIMD measured 0.009476691 s. SIMD and k-unrolling follow-ups measured 0.010415142 s and 0.009647238 s, so this candidate keeps the plain contiguous row update and tests one contrasting change: initialize each C row inside its statically assigned row iteration instead of using a separate serial memset. This may improve output first-touch locality or have no benefit; no speedup is assumed.

retained: Remove the separate serial memset and initialize each output row to zero inside the iteration that owns that row.
Parallelize independent rows with static OpenMP scheduling, capped at min(threads, N).
Retain ascending-k accumulation and contiguous c traversal; do not add explicit SIMD or unrolling.
